name: build-error
about: A project that does not build before the work: Report.cs has an error of its own (CS0103, 'totl'). The task is elsewhere - add Median to Stats. The truth: Median is there, Report.cs is left alone, and the build fails with the one error it failed with before, no more. The run is Completed: the engine must not hold an error that was already there against the work.
